name: AstraLogCore
description: Distributed audit logging extension for Celestia Nova.
longDescription: AstraLogCore receives NOVA_LOG entries forwarded from all Celestia Nova instances, categorizes them by sender, severity, and timestamp, and optionally pushes them to a configured database via a DatabaseOrchestrator. Only instances holding a valid authoritative JWT (issued by NovaID through AegisCore and stored via KeyForge) may push to prevent duplication across the mesh.
